tbesh_html:
1) to divide, break in two
1a) (Qal) to break, break up
1b) (Hiphil) to be divided (of hoofs)
Aramaic equivalent: pe.ras (פְּרַס "to divide" H6537A)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to break in pieces, i.e. (usually without violence) to split, distribute
strongs_1890.kjv_def: deal, divide, have hoofs, part, tear.
